TCD.note: Only an AI strategy being developed; no rule or authority on AI harms.
A strategy only; no AI system in use stated.
Nothing on AI built in the country.
Two data centres named in N'Djamena but not stated to rent to others.

facts.fact: Minister Haliki Choua Mahamat told the ITU PP-26 that Chad is developing three national strategies, one of them on data governance.
The minister said 500 sites are being deployed with World Bank support to cover white spots, and another 1,000 are planned.

TCD.note: Only a strategy for digitalising administration; no online service stated.

facts.fact: The minister stated that N'Djamena has an Internet Exchange Point.
The minister said three international fibre links have been completed with Cameroon and Sudan, two different neighbours.
facts.system: fibre links to Cameroon and Sudan

TCD.note: Owner and hire of the two N'Djamena data centres not stated.
Links with Cameroon and Sudan named, but no arrangement or party in each country stated.
